title: Bent parts/parts missing. LOUD SQUEAK
text:
Bent parts/parts missing. LOUD SQUEAK. I bought the full over twin trundle for my kids. Assembly was organized and explained in a fairly simple way, however one of the large pieces I received was bent so it threw everything out of whack. We managed to get it put together (minus the 3 slats that were missing) and were pretty happy with it for 3 days.

THEN THE SQUEAKING. I don’t know how people say that the bed is quiet. It squeaks every time my 12 year old 65 lb daughter moves!!! Overall super disappointed. Especially for the price and the amount of time it took to get to me!
